newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Telefonica del Peru.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caspian starts Telefonica del Peru.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities Inc said it initiated coverage of Telefonica del Peru with a buy rating and set a 12-month price target of $23 per ADS.
-- Caspian said Telefonica del Peru has strong fundamentals due to a favorable telecommunications regulatory environment and strong telephone line-growth trends.
-- Caspian said Telefonica has made aggressive workforce reductions and has a favorable labor agreement, which should help keep costs down.
-- With three-year annual gross cash flow growth averaging 20-22 percent, Caspian said Telefonica is now undervalued by 23 percent.
